title: Major versions
statement:
Compare the major number of the installed version with that of the latest version.

The input has `current` and `latest`, both text like `"1.4.2"`. The major number is the part before the first dot, as a number. Give an object with three keys. `current` is the major number of the installed version. `latest` is the major number of the latest version. `update` is `true` when the latest major number is larger, and `false` when it is not.
reference:
def major: split(".") | .[0] | tonumber;
{current: (.current | major), latest: (.latest | major), update: ((.latest | major) > (.current | major))}
